description:
MOTOR Power, premium, passion. Quiet and lightweight, the 90Nm Performance Line PX responds precisely to inputs and supports the rider naturally thanks to its low pedal resistance. The robust drivetrain makes this motor particularly reliable, even on long tours with heavy luggage. DRUMS With the PowerTube 800, you're ready for long rides. Ideal for all your daily commutes, as well as longer weekend excursions. It integrates seamlessly into the frame for a sleek, clean eBike look. DISPLAY The perfect travel companion: The Kiox 500 is extra large, smart, and robust. The ideal display for your next adventure, with navigation and alerts. More connected and personalized With the eBike Flow app, you can connect your smartphone to MONACO for a better, more connected, safer, and more personalized riding experience. You can customize assistance modes, adjust the drive unit's performance parameters, update your e-bike, access the owner's manual, and use the navigation function. You can also use your smartphone as a digital key to unlock your e-bike, and the removable Kiox 500 display to activate the motor. DISCOVER MORE

Comfort, power, adventure: all in one ride. MONACO is a full-suspension trekking bike with an 800 Wh battery, designed to take you anywhere in maximum comfort. The 90 and 100 mm dual suspension absorbs bumps in the trail, ensuring comfort and control even on the most challenging routes. The standard equipment includes all the ideal accessories for medium- to long-distance travel, such as a double rack, fenders, and lights. The 90 Nm Bosch PX motor provides powerful yet progressive assistance, for a smooth, natural pedaling experience that perfectly matches the rider's riding style. Thanks to the integrated Smart System and the eBike Flow app, you can customize your riding experience down to the last detail. IDEAL FOR The MONACO is one of the most versatile e-bikes you'll ever encounter. Ideal for mixed routes, it's equally at home on asphalt, dirt roads, cobblestones, or gravel roads. PERFECT FOR YOU IF If you're looking for a complete, reliable, and comfortable bike for your commute or for Sunday rides on hilly paths, embankments, or dirt roads.
